summary.zh-CN: 修复 Linux 服务器从页面更新后没有自动重新启动、版本仍停在旧版的问题。
summary.en-US: Fixes Linux in-app updates that did not restart the service and left the running version unchanged.

title.zh-CN: Linux 页面更新自动重启
title.en-US: Automatic restart after Linux in-app updates

body.zh-CN: 旧版 systemd 安装在应用更新后会重新启动并运行下载的新版本，不再停在等待重启状态。
body.en-US: Older systemd installations restart into the downloaded version after an update instead of remaining at restart required.

body.zh-CN: 旧 systemd 配置无需先手工迁移；终端手动运行时仍保持手动重启。
body.en-US: Older systemd configurations need no manual migration, while terminal-run instances keep manual restart behavior.
